title: Normalized style plan
description: The contract between shesha-design-system and the form compiler. A brand token file is authored for humans — nested palettes and roles.* indirection. A style plan is what the compiler consumes: every role already dereferenced to a concrete value, flat, complete. scripts/resolve-style-plan.mjs produces one from a <brand>.tokens.json and validates it against this schema, so a token file missing a role the compiler needs fails loudly instead of silently emitting an unbranded form.

brand.description: The token file's $brand, carried through so emitted markup is traceable to a brand.

pageBg.description: page canvas — the styled-ness gate looks for this

sectionHeading.description: not necessarily the brand colour — Shesha reserves brand for interactive affordances

inputBorder.description: makes inputs visible before the app-level AntD theme is applied

hairline.description: 1px separators — Shesha default style is borders, not shadows

appPrimary.description: interactive anchor. Applied via the app theme, never per button

semiboldWeight.description: font-weight for headings and card titles; unstyled headings render at body size and the page loses hierarchy

headingSizes.description: by heading level: 1 = page title … 4 = label

color.description: A concrete colour value. An unresolved token path here means resolution failed.

length.description: A concrete length. An unresolved token path here means resolution failed.
